Decisions moved from append into the shared helper, and its function base adds one total complexity point. No total line/complexity reduction is claimed. validateBody, validateTransition and validateAgentBackendDatabase fingerprints are unchanged.

limits: This is bounded STORE-01 implementation and manual source/caller review, not a separate security audit or semantic unused-code proof.
Focused source and compiled/native gates plus own all-project typecheck do not substitute for Root combined full regression on integrated main. No shared dist/build output was written.

A copied active native history supplies evidence to recovery testing only; the actual Original Engine owns and completes process cleanup before administrative operations. No provider/process handle is recreated from history.
